step_by_step_reasoning: The transcript and whiteboard layout describe a multi-tenant cloud architecture. Tenants are isolated using AWS Organizations managed under AWS Control Tower. The core application runs inside EC2 instance clusters behind an ALB, storing shared state on EFS. Users authenticate with Amazon Cognito. The EC2 instances access customer on-premises environments via an AWS Site-to-Site VPN. A separate serverless DevOps pipeline built with S3, API Gateway, and Lambda manages these multi-account environments.

graph.name: Appway Multi-Tenant Financial Services SaaS Platform
graph.notes: Multi-tenant architecture isolating each banking customer inside its own AWS organization account. Management and guardrails are applied globally via AWS Control Tower.
